structure: CSharp EmitFlowExpression applies materialize to its source and dispatches the selected final printer independently; its result is Unit. Native AST has an outer println flow and inner materialize flow with distinct owners.
branches: resolvedFlowIntrinsicOpcode already recognizes exact selected Console calls, but only suppresses inherited mapPath (-214). A ValueFlowExpression envelope can use the raw-token fallback, retaining the preceding materialize (-229) despite final println.
logic: An exactly selected final Console call must return no producer intrinsic opcode before any broad token scan. The separate source AST still owns materialize and its Arena argument. Ordinary shadowing and control-only fallback rules retain their paths.
diagnostics: Preserve expression-statement rejection for actual non-Unit results. Remove the wrong producer classification rather than skipping semantic checks or changing stdout/oracles.
